messages:
linda: Heads up — kitchen update + tiny poll. Left a box of scones (2 plain, 1 cinnamon) on the counter with a sticky note 'courtesy of ops'. Please take by 3pm or i'll donate to the downstairs cafe fridge. Also thinking of switching coffee beans to a dark roast next week — quick thumbs up/down?

sam: grabbing a scone now! :yum: thumbs up for dark roast from me.

maya: down for dark roast, our current medium is a bit light for afternoon. i'll bring honey butter for the scones at 2:30.

aj: thumbs down on dark roast personally (i like fruity notes) but happy to go with consensus. poll: react :thumbsup: for dark, :thumbsdown: to keep medium.

rob: donated sugar packets to the community jar. also left a small sign on the sink: 'Please rinse Tupperware before putting in dishwasher' — it was getting rough this week.

pantry-bot: Quick inventory: coffee beans medium roast = 120g, dark roast = 0g, oat milk = 1 cart, almond milk = 3 carts. To request reorder: `/restock coffee beans dark 1` or react with :package:.

linda: thanks rob — i'll print a laminated version of the sink sign. aj — let's run the emoji poll for 24h. whoever wins i will order 1 bag.

sam: also FYI the scone box had a tiny note "from <3 ops parking lot" so maybe someone left extra from an event. no allergens listed so assume contains eggs/dairy.

maya: labeled the honey butter container `maya - honey butter` and put it in the middle shelf.

aj: :thumbsup: (dark roast) — noted about allergens. i'll bring a French press tomorrow morning for anyone who wants stronger coffee.

rob: if dark roast wins i'll donate a spare tin I have at home. :coffee: anyone want the tin for storage?

linda: poll ends 24h from now. whoever wants to pick up the order please ping me. thanks team!

pantry-bot: Poll recorded: dark roast reactions = 3, keep medium = 1. Restock queued if confirmed.
